title: C: common windows and complete-operation scheduling
description:
Connect receiver-aware intervals in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c to lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_rx.c and the existing lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_airtime.c calculator. Own complete-operation geometry beyond the reused zephyr.06 frame-plus-guard minimum: setup/retune/CCA, complete signed PHY frame, any explicitly reserved turnaround/response and one trailing guard. Schedule common CH0 windows and data opportunities without preempting RX or changing fixed profile 0x01.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: zephyr.06 aliases b7z9.17 and may deliver only the minimum slot calculation. This leaf explicitly owns the remaining complete-operation admission, using actual frame lengths and driver costs; zephyr.14 verifies it end to end. Compose grants, driver capability and real clock inputs without a new framework or guessed 100 us retune/cadence. Preserve baseline SCHC/security, radio-owned identity and custody; no hardware/RF access or experimental PHY activation.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.04/.06 through the production scheduler and RX arm/disarm boundary. Test exact fit and one-unit late, setup consuming slack, 2295808 us SF10/255-byte airtime, 2346 ms frame-plus-guard insufficiency when other costs apply, separate response opportunities, control-window return, expiry and uncertain settling/clock bounds. Verify one radio cannot listen elsewhere while claiming CH0. Extend lichen/tests/tdma_guard_budget and TDMA-enabled lichen/tests/ping_l2/native cases; run local Linux/heft sanitizers/lint against the verified west pin, currently v4.1.0.
